items.title: Critical PHP Vulnerability Hits Magento, WooCommerce and Other Ecommerce Platforms
items.summary: Two critical PHP flaws affecting Magento and other platforms allow an attacker to run their own code on the server or read data. The vulnerabilities are in PHP itself, not the Magento software.

items.title: BlockStrap: Magento and Adobe Commerce RCE
items.summary: BlockStrap is a critical flaw (CVSS 10.0) in Magento's email template engine that enables unauthenticated remote code execution. Adobe released a fix on October 13 in APSB26-153, but new installations may still require a manual patch.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce - APSB26-138
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: StyleSmuggler is a zero-day vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) allowing unauthenticated remote code execution in Magento and Adobe Commerce, which was under active exploitation. Adobe published an emergency hotfix on September 7, 2026.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce - APSB25-71
items.summary: This security update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.
